run_gen_stats_data: run the gen_stats_data.py script to generate C++ stats header and source files from a YAML definition
gen_bucket_code_histogram: generate optimized C code for histogram bucket lookup using bit shifting and mapping tables
find_ideal_shift_bounds: find the ideal bit shift value for histogram bucket bounds to minimize lookup table size
decl_static_table_values: declare and deduplicate static lookup tables for histogram bucket boundaries and mapping data
c_str_escape: escape a Python string into a valid C string literal with octal encoding for special characters
